records.source: AN IMAGE THE DETECTOR FINDS NOTHING IN IS COPIED INTO THE SPLIT FOLDER WHOLE, with no geometry, so it is still analysed and simply has no ruler. A warning that says "passed through whole" and then skips the image passes nothing through: when some images in a folder split and others did not, the others would contribute no crop and no row and nothing would say they had existed. The all-or-nothing case -- where the function falls back to ``src`` -- is the only one that would behave as the message promised.

The all-or-nothing case -- where the function falls back to ``src`` -- is the only one that would behave as the message promised.

records.label: spacr.suggest#4
records.source: 1. A SUGGESTION IS NEVER CONFUSABLE WITH A DECISION. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a run that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A SUGGESTION NEVER OVERWRITES AN ANNOTATION. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a re-run. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a run came out wrong. 3. NO CONFIDENCE FLOOR, SO THE ORDER CARRIES THE DOUBT. Every unannotated crop gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision for them, with a number nobody chose. 4. A JUDGEMENT IS RECORDED, NOT INFERRED (item 512). Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- where a NULL would have been silence. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.context: 1. A suggestion is never confusable with a decision. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a processing session that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. a suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a repeat execution. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a processing session came out wrong. 3. no confidence floor, so the order carries the doubt. Every unannotated extracted image region gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision for them, with a number nobody chose. 4. a judgement is recorded, not inferred (item 512). Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- where a NULL would have been silence. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.translation: 1. “建议绝不会与决定混淆。”建议以其自身的值存储——建议的 1 变为 11——因此读取标注列的任何代码都不会把建议误认为人工的答案，而一次出错的运行只需删除一个值即可撤销，无需记住改动过哪些行。2. “建议绝不会覆盖标注。”写入操作带有 ``IS NULL``。模型置信度高时不会，重新运行时也不会。人工标签是模型拟合所依据的参考标注；悄无声息地丢失一个会耗费数小时，而且要到某次运行结果出错时才会被发现。3. “没有置信度下限，因此由排序承载不确定性。”每个未标注的裁剪图都会得到一条建议，按置信度从高到低排序，审阅者在不再认同之处停下即可。阈值会替他们做出这个决定，而且用的是一个无人选择的数字。4. “判定是被记录的，而不是推断的”（第 512 项）。确认一条建议会把它变为普通标签，拒绝则会清除它——两者都会记录在该列旁边的 ``<column>_verdict`` 中，记为被确认（``+c``）或被拒绝（``-c``）的类别。拒绝是下一轮训练可以利用的信息——在二分类列中，"not class 1" 就是类别 2 的一个样本——而 NULL 则什么也不表达。判定列会在首次打开数据源时添加，因此在它出现之前创建的表无需迁移步骤即可获得该列。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.timeflows_baseline.identity_switches#1
records.source: Each ground-truth track is walked in frame order over the frames where it was detected, and every change of computed label is one switch. Frames where the object was missed are skipped rather than ending the track, so an object that is lost and then found again under a NEW id is counted as a switch. That is the failure a biologist reads as "the cell became another cell", and a tracker that hides it by dropping the frame should not score better for dropping it.
records.context: Each ground-truth track is walked in frame order over the frames where it was detected, and every change of computed label is one switch. Frames where the object was missed are skipped rather than ending the track, so an object that is lost and then found again under a NEW id is counted as a switch. That is the failure a biologist reads as "the cell became another cell", and a tracker that hides it by dropping the frame should not score better for dropping it.
records.translation: 每条参考标注轨迹按帧顺序遍历其被检测到的各帧，计算标签的每一次变化记为一次切换。对象被漏检的帧会被跳过，而不会终止轨迹，因此一个丢失后又以“新” ID 被重新找到的对象会被计为一次切换。这正是生物学家理解为“这个细胞变成了另一个细胞”的失败，而通过丢弃该帧来掩盖它的跟踪器不应因此得到更高的分数。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
